The House Bill 51 By: Representatives Burchett of Committee on Rural Development offers the 176th, Corbett of the 174th, Greene of the 154th, O’Steen of the 169th, and Ford of the 170th following substitute to HB 51:
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 23 of Title 50 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to the Georgia Environmental Finance Authority, so as to authorize the authority to finance and perform … solid waste; or (D) For the purposes of carrying out a community land conservation project or a state land conservation project pursuant to Chapter 22 of Title 36; or
(E) For the purposes of storing, supplying, and distributing natural gas, gas outside any certified area of a nonmunicipal gas company, as such term is defined in paragraph (5) of Code Section 46-1-1, including, but not limited to, pipelines, storage tanks and facilities, natural gas distribution systems, equipment, vehicles, conveyances, real or personal property or rights therein and appurtenances, furnishings, accessories, and devices thereto necessary or useful and convenient for the storage, supply, … or"
SECTION 4. This Act shall become effective upon its approval by the Governor or upon its becoming law without such approval.
SECTION 5. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
